description: Declarative genome of Hub spokes for tools/hub-sync.py (B-239, ADR-024 I-4). The tool reads this file from the pinned Hub SHA. Units are the scope tokens; 'genome' is the base structure, other units are optional practices. Content of the genome is fixed by B-240; this file records the current de-facto genome (E1 of ops/hub-project-extraction-contract.md for archetype B, templates/htom for archetype D).

genome.description: Spoke genome: templates/spoke plus HTOM issue templates and the AGENTS.md bootstrap validator (same map as E1).
HTOM genome: templates/htom without the one-shot init.sh and the project README.
